description: IRIDIUM BURSTS from EXPERIMENTS: hops Iridium's simplex channels at 1626 MHz (or the whole 1616-1626.5 MHz band) on the LR2021 or an SDR and counts the satellites' TDMA bursts: a bar per channel that brightens with fresh bursts and marks the one being listened to, bursts a second over the last minute, and a Doppler trace of the strongest channel each cycle as a pass moves it. Energy and timing only. Needs open sky.
